map.输入目标色与基漆质量，按色浆比例（浅色 0.3-1%、中色 1-3%、深色 3-: Enter the target color and the base paint mass, and compute the color paste needed from the paste ratio (light 0.3-1%, medium 1-3%, dark 3-8%), assisting precise latex paint color matching.
map.色浆比例 = 色浆质量 ÷ 乳胶漆质量 × 100%: Color paste ratio = color paste mass / latex paint mass x 100%
map.墙面浅色补漆：已知基漆 5kg，选浅色比例 0.5%，得色浆 ≈ 5×0.005: Light wall touch-up: with 5 kg of base paint known and a light tint ratio of 0.5%, the color paste is about 5 x 0.005 = 0.025 kg; confirm with a small sample before a large batch.
map.中深色背景墙：深色比例升至 3%–8%，量大时建议分批加浆并搅拌后比对色卡。: Medium to dark accent walls: raise the dark ratio to 3%-8%, and for large volumes add the paste in batches and stir before comparing against the color card.
map.多桶同色复配：按总基漆质量统一折算色浆，避免分批比例漂移导致色差。: Recoloring with multiple buckets of the same color: convert the color paste against the total base paint mass so batch-to-batch ratio drift does not cause color differences.
map.：示例：基漆 10kg，目标中色，色浆比例取 2%。\n• 色浆量 ≈ 10 ×:
Example: 10 kg of base paint with a target mid tone and a paste ratio of 2%.
- Color paste = 10 x 0.02 = 0.20 kg
- Try mixing with 0.5 kg of base paint first, then scale up by the same ratio once confirmed
map.比例怎么定？: How should the ratio be set?
map.浅色 0.3%–1%、中色 1%–3%、深色 3%–8%，具体看色浆浓度与基漆白: Light 0.3%-1%, medium 1%-3%, dark 3%-8%, depending on the paste concentration and the base paint brightness.
map.调出来有色差？: Is there a color difference when mixed?
map.不同批次基漆、含水量、搅拌不均都会偏色，务必先小样比对色卡再大批。: Different batches of base paint, differing water content and uneven mixing all shift color, so always compare a small sample against the color card before doing a large batch.
map.深色为什么费浆？: Why do dark colors cost more paste?
map.深色遮盖力差、需更多色浆饱和，比例显著更高；建议分次加浆避免一次过深。: Dark colors have poor covering power and need more paste to become saturated, so the ratio is significantly higher; add the paste in steps to avoid going too dark at once.
